values.note: 2025-2026: RV pads #1-#6 $55 a night including water and electric; tent camping $50. Online payments carry a service fee. A camper parked on a rented pavilion spot pays the camping fee too.

fees.source: https://www.cambriacountypa.gov/duman-park ('NEW Camping Rates for 2025-2026 #1 - #6 RV Pad $55.00 per night (includes water and electric) Tent Camping $50.00 per night'), read 2026-10-20

sites.source: https://www.cambriacountypa.gov/duman-park ('The park has six campsites available for overnight occupancy. Each site is equipped with electric, water, a picnic table, and a fire ring.'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campers must be self-contained before May 15 and after September 15, when the park's restrooms and pavilions are closed.

season.source: https://www.cambriacountypa.gov/duman-park ('Camping Season: April 15th - October 15th', 'Prior to May 15th to September 15th, all campers MUST be self-contained', 'May 15th through September 15th ... Pavilions and restrooms are available for use'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Check the county's online reservation calendar, then submit the online camping reservation form (or call 814-472-8390, Mon-Fri 7am-3pm); staff contact you to confirm and take payment, online payments with a service fee. Phone requests are held 5 days for the formal application. Check-in 4 pm, check-out 2 pm.

booking.source: https://www.cambriacountypa.gov/duman-park ('Please Make Reservations Monday - Friday from 7am to 3pm Phone: (814) 472-8390', 'Before booking, please locate the Reservation Calendar, Fill out the Reservation Forms, and a staff member will be in contact with you', ONLINE CAMPING RESERVATION FORM, FAQs), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed 6 sites with electric and water, reservable, seasonal. Added fees $55 RV pad (2025-2026), season Apr 15-Oct 15 (self-contained outside May 15-Sep 15), booking via the county's calendar + online form/phone. Not stated by the county: amperage (30 left as derived), rig length (40 left as derived), showers (page says 'modern restrooms').
flags: Price over gate: the county's 2025-2026 rate is $55 a night for an RV pad (water + electric), over the US$50 base-rate gate; Ebensburg is not a gateway. Matters only if the family has not stayed here.
Wrong phone: entry has 814-948-6247; the county publishes (814) 472-8390 for camping reservations (County Operations Office) on https://www.cambriacountypa.gov/duman-park.
Missing operator website: the entry has none; official page is https://www.cambriacountypa.gov/duman-park (bot-protected: 403 to plain HTTP).
